# ClaudeMC v1.19.3 — mixin crash fixes (Minecraft 1.21.1)

This is the last 1.21.1-compatible build. It fixes three mixin failures that
prevented Minecraft from launching with the mod installed. (Minecraft 1.21.11
support arrives in v1.20.0.)

## Bug fixes

### ScreenMixin — `Screen.charTyped` injection had no valid target
`charTyped` is a default method on the `Element` interface; `Screen` never
overrides it, so there was no method in `Screen`'s bytecode to inject into and
Mixin aborted with a critical injection failure. The `@Inject` was removed and
character input for the ChatOverlay is now captured via a chained GLFW character
callback registered in `ClaudeMCClient`, preserving vanilla input.

### TitleScreenMixin — `@Shadow` on inherited members failed
`@Shadow` on `addDrawableChild` and `width` could not be resolved because both
are declared in the parent class `Screen`, not in `TitleScreen`. The mixin class
now `extends Screen`, so those members are accessed directly without `@Shadow`.

### ClientPlayNetworkHandlerMixin — wrong `onCustomPayload` parameter type
The handler declared `CustomPayloadS2CPacket` but `onCustomPayload` takes a
`CustomPayload` directly in 1.21.1, causing an invalid-descriptor failure during
mixin apply. The parameter type was corrected and the payload id is now read via
`payload.getId().id().toString()`.

All mixins verified to apply cleanly at runtime; the mod initialises without
errors.
